scope: new deterministic synthetic contract probes; no preflight, learner, API or saved user checkpoint
expected_invariants: A leg-region hazard >=0.65 latches all three ipsilateral joints, including postural forces.
Full postural allocation fraction does not establish full requested support.
Zero optional work alone does not make a loaded latched leg valid.
Pressure-feasible opposite-foot contact alone does not prove a reachable transition.
An already unloaded painful leg may preserve healthy-leg support without restoring posture.
Energy conservation and physical-model validity are distinct outcomes.
evidence_limits: Numerical cross-checks of a reduced engineering fixture, not independent biological or physical validation.
